text: [220] 16 navayimā bhikkhave saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā . katamā nava asubhasaññā maraṇasaññā āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā 1 aniccasaññā anicce dukkhasaññā dukkhe anattasaññā pahānasaññā virāgasaññā . imā kho bhikkhave nava saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti .
